desc: The IR-HUNTER thermal riflescope is a compact, rugged, powerful thermal optic that enables target acquisition in any light. The turret style controls make nighttime operation easy, even while wearing gloves. USB-C connection port can be used to utilize external power source to extend run time. Record your hunt to share with family and friends with the integrated Digital Video Recorder with SD Card, or via the USB-C port to an external recorder. Engineered to last and built in the US
